LUCI.TITLE: LUCI
LUCI.SUBTITLE: Your support assistant. Everything here takes effect on the next message — no restart needed.
LUCI.NO_INBOX: no inbox yet — link her under Settings, Bots
LUCI.LABEL_RULE: Only in conversations carrying the \u201c{label}\u201d label.
LUCI.PROMPT_PLACEHOLDER: Who LUCI is, how she writes, what she must never say, and when to call a human.
LUCI.PROMPT_HINT: Her personality and rules. Be specific about when she should hand a conversation over.
LUCI.KNOWLEDGE_PLACEHOLDER: Services, how the process works, frequently asked questions, what she must not promise.
LUCI.KNOWLEDGE_HINT: What she knows about the company. The longer this gets, the cheaper each message becomes — this part is cached.
LUCI.LABEL: Label that activates her
LUCI.LABEL_HINT: Add this label to a conversation and LUCI takes part. Remove it and she stops.

MODEL_COST.SONNET: Middle ground, about twice the cost of Haiku.
MODEL_COST.OPUS: Most capable, about five times the cost of Haiku.
